STEP 1 — ONBOARDING
Five boxes, thirty seconds: name, email, mobile, what they sell, what they charge. The price box is the one that makes everything after this personal — and green.

STEP 2 — DIAGNOSIS
Their own business, drawn as disconnected parts. The payment link shows +$250 arriving and a red line underneath: then absolutely nothing.

STEP 3 — THE TEACHING
The five parts every AI system has. Then the reveal: ChatGPT is part three, and only part three.

STEP 4 — THE MOMENT
They buy from themselves in test mode. Green pulse travels the wire, the log prints every step, and +$250.00 lands on their phone at the same instant.

STEP 5 — THE DIFFERENCE
Same $250, two worlds. The money row is the closer: $250 today either way, then $0 on Wednesday vs +$250 on Wednesday.

FOR VANDA, NOT FOR THEM
End-to-end flow, the folder in plain English, and real running costs. Read the green box — that's why you can hand this to a thousand strangers and nobody is charged a cent.
